leads.title: Illinois Human Rights Act
leads.documents: State anti-discrimination machinery covering employment, housing, public accommodations and credit on grounds including sexual orientation, explicitly defined to include gender-related identity
leads.detail: Quoted definition: 'Sexual orientation means actual or perceived heterosexuality, homosexuality, bisexuality, or gender-related identity'; effective protections since June 1, 2006; Chicago anti-discrimination ordinance 1988 noted as local precursor

leads.title: HB 3930 - Illinois hate crime statute amendment
leads.documents: Addition of 'gender identity' to Illinois hate crime law, which since 1991 covered actual or perceived sexual orientation
leads.detail: Passed House April 16 and Senate May 20, 2015 unanimously; signed by Governor Bruce Rauner July 20, 2015; effective January 1, 2016

leads.title: SB1761 - gay and trans panic defense repeal
leads.documents: Repeal of gay and trans panic defense in Illinois
leads.detail: Passed Illinois General Assembly unanimously June 2017; signed by Governor Bruce Rauner August 25, 2017; effective January 1, 2018

leads.title: Youth Mental Health Protection Act - conversion therapy ban
leads.documents: Prohibits mental health providers from practicing conversion therapy / sexual orientation change efforts on minors under 18; federal court limit for religious counseling
leads.detail: Passed House 68-43 May 19, 2015 and Senate 34-19 May 29; signed August 20, 2015; effective January 1, 2016; U.S. District Court for Northern District of Illinois dismissed pastors' suit Feb 15, 2017 as nonjusticiable - private religious counseling not 'trade or commerce'

leads.title: Illinois gender-affirming care shield law and TGD Program
leads.documents: Legal protection for gender-affirming care within Illinois and for out-of-state individuals seeking care in Illinois; Medicaid coverage and state equity program
leads.detail: Bill passed both houses January 2023, signed January 13, 2023 effective immediately; Illinois Medicaid covers reassignment surgery for 21+; June 2024 announcement of Transgender and Gender Diverse (TGD) Wellness and Equity Program by Dept of Human Services and Public Health Institute of Metropolitan Chicago

leads.title: Illinois birth certificate and ID gender marker reforms
leads.documents: Removal of surgery requirement for legal gender change; process for M/F/X markers on birth certificates, driver's licenses and state IDs; recognition of transgender parent as birth parent
leads.detail: Reform bill passed 63-43 House, 32-22 Senate May 31, 2017, signed Aug 25, 2017 effective Jan 1, 2018; forms cited: 'Affidavit and Certificate of Correction Request', 'Declaration of Gender Transition/Intersex Condition', Secretary of State 'Gender Designation Change Form', $15 fee; X option July 2020 on birth certificates, from 2024 on licenses; 2023 re-introduced reform effective July 1; out-of-state-born change allowed since July 1, 2024; Lambda Legal-assisted transgender father case Jan 2020

leads.title: Illinois gender-neutral bathroom laws and Chicago Human Rights Ordinance
leads.documents: State requirement for public single-occupancy restrooms as gender-neutral; Chicago self-determination rule for bathroom access; Chicago public schools all-gender bathrooms
leads.detail: Chicago Mayor Rahm Emanuel proposal May 2016: 'Each person determines his or her own gender identity'; approved by City Council a month later; State bill passed House 109-5, Senate 53-0 May 2019, signed July 2019 by Gov. J.B. Pritzker effective Jan 1, 2020; multi-occupancy expansion lapsed 2021, repassed May 2023; Chicago schools all gender bathrooms by signage since Dec 2021

leads.title: Illinois anti-bullying law expansion and Governor's Executive Order on transgender students + HB246 LGBT curriculum
leads.documents: School protections prohibiting bullying on sexual orientation and gender identity/expression; executive task force on names, pronouns, dress codes; mandatory LGBT history curriculum
leads.detail: 2014 anti-bullying expansion; Executive Order signed June 30, 2019 by Gov. J.B. Pritzker effective immediately; HB246 passed House 60-42 Senate 37-17 May 2019, signed Aug 2019 effective July 1, 2020; mandatory K-12 sex education bill passed May 2021 signed Aug 2021 effective Aug 1, 2022

leads.title: Lurie Children's Hospital intersex apology
leads.documents: Documented institutional incident on intersex rights - past non-consensual infant genital surgeries to make genitalia appear typically male/female
leads.detail: Apology July 2020; announced cessation unless medically necessary; Dr. Ellie Kim cited as first doctor at hospital to speak out publicly

leads.title: Illinois' Equality Profile - via the Movement Advancement Project
leads.documents: Institutional equality profile aggregating Illinois LGBTQ legal status and rights machinery
leads.detail: Cited under External links as 'Illinois' Equality Profile - via the Movement Advancement Project'; companion link 'LGBT Rights in Illinois - via Equaldex'
